items.title: Qantas set to award Boeing bulk of 20-jet order, Bloomberg reports

items.title: Why BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) Is Back In The Spotlight
items.summary: BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) has just landed a fresh set of space and defense wins, from NASA's PRIMA mission work to a new Virginia-class submarine propulsor contract, alongside reaffirmed 2026 sales guidance.
